name: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
summary: In Brill, That Shadowvale Green Elixir draws buyers despite the old ban. Shadowvale's secluded villagers once brewed Whispering Elixir from local herbs, and the Scourge left the village in ruins.

sections.title: A Banned Brew
sections.body: Before the Scourge came, Shadowvale's villagers brewed Whispering Elixir from rare herbs found only in Tirisfal Glades. The draught grew known across northern Lordaeron. The Capital City outlawed it, yet mystics, poisoners, and apothecaries still sought its unusual properties, defying royal decrees.

sections.title: Ruins in the Whispering Forest
sections.body:
Shadowvale lies deep in the Whispering Forest of western Tirisfal. Its people were insular and distrustful, and rarely welcomed outsiders. The Scourge invasion left the settlement in ruins, though forgotten stores of aged green elixir remain among the wreckage.

Carolai Anise works from Brill. The underworld still wants the brew, so she pays adventurers willing to brave the forest's unsettling silence.

sections.title: The Whispering Curse
sections.body: Carolai Anise dismisses the rumors as superstition, but the Whispering Forest has a dark reputation. Local lore says an ancient curse taints its soil and roots, then seeps into the plants Shadowvale's brewers harvested. Whatever malevolence lingers around the abandoned hamlet, distant buyers still hunger for its bottled remnants.

faq.answer: Shadowvale was a secluded village deep in the Whispering Forest of western Tirisfal Glades. Before the Scourge overran the region, its secretive people distilled rare brews from local herbs.
Whispering Elixir is a potent green draught brewed from herbs found only in Tirisfal. Mystics, poisoners, and apothecaries sought it, though the Capital City outlawed it before Lordaeron fell.

aliases: who gives that shadowvale green elixir quest
faq.answer: Carolai Anise is a Forsaken resident of Brill. She brokers valuable banned curios, including Shadowvale's elixir, for buyers across the realm.

faq.q: Why was the elixir banned in the Capital City?
faq.answer: No reason for the ban is given. Carolai says only that the Capital City outlawed the elixir, though apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners sought it. Some blame a curse in the Whispering Forest and its roots, but Carolai dismisses that as superstition and never links it to the ban.

faq.q: Why is the Whispering Forest considered dangerous?
faq.answer: The Whispering Forest, west of Deathknell, is considered eerie and cursed. Those who venture there speak of deep malevolence and strange woodland phenomena. Rumors say the forest's soil tainted its herbs.

faq.q: Who are the buyers wanting this elixir?
faq.answer: Carolai Anise says several buyers seek surviving bottles from before the war, but she does not name them.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you can profit by recovering Lordaeron's forgotten brews and use them to fuel apothecary experiments in the fledgling Undercity.
As a rogue, you know poisoners and scoundrels prized Whispering Elixir when they worked beyond the notice of Lordaeron's former magistrates.
As a herbalist, you know the elixir draws its potency from rare herbs that grow only beneath the Whispering Forest's eerie canopy.
